limit.off: Pulse limit switched off for this workout

guide.astrand.settle: Åstrand test: keep an even cadence (about 60 rpm) while the pulse settles. The pulse is measured from {from} to {to}.
guide.astrand.tooLow: The pulse ({pulse}) looks like ending below 120: choose a higher load next time.
guide.astrand.tooHigh: The pulse ({pulse}) looks like ending above 170: choose a lower load next time.
guide.astrand.first: Measuring pulse {from}-{to} · average so far: {average}. Keep the cadence even.
guide.astrand.unstable: The pulse is not steady yet.
guide.astrand.range: The pulse must be between 120 and 170 for the test to be valid.
guide.ramp: Ramp test: now {watts} W, +20 W per minute. Ride as long as you can, and press Stop when you cannot go on. Highest pulse so far: {peak}.
guide.recovery: Pulse drop: sit still until {until} · pulse at start ({start}): {startPulse} · now: {now}.
chart.title.power: Load and pulse through the workout
chart.aria: Chart of target and measured pulse during the workout. Drag blue target lines to change the pulse and orange diamonds to change the duration.
chart.help.initial: Drag a blue target line to change the pulse, or an orange diamond to change the duration. During a workout, changes take effect at the next adjustment.
chart.help.pulse: Drag a blue target line to change the pulse, or an orange diamond to change the duration. In repeats, all bars of the same kind change. During a workout, changes take effect at the next adjustment.
chart.help.power: Drag the top of an orange bar to change the load, or an orange diamond to change the duration. In repeats, all bars of the same kind change. During a workout, changes take effect at the next adjustment.
chart.message.initial: The chart follows the workout plan and updates once a second.
chart.message.emptyPower: Add steps, ramps or repeats to see the chart.
chart.message.emptyPulse: Choose a maximum pulse and add intervals to see the chart.
chart.message.demo: Live demo: the readings are simulated. The chart shows the demo's plan; changes apply next time.
chart.message.demoDone: Live demo finished. The red readings are simulated, and the plan can be edited.
chart.message.limited: The pulse limit has been reached, so the load is lowered for now until the pulse drops again.
chart.message.live: Live: the measured pulse is recorded about once a second.
chart.message.done: The workout has finished. The chart shows the readings, and the plan can be edited.
chart.message.power: The chart shows the planned load in watts. The measured pulse is shown on the right axis during the workout.
chart.message.percent: The chart shows your pulse targets as a percentage of maximum. Choose a maximum pulse to see bpm.
chart.message.pulse: The chart shows the planned pulse targets. Play the live demo for simulated pulse readings.
chart.svg.title.power: Planned load and measured pulse during the workout
chart.svg.title.pulse: Target and measured pulse during the workout
chart.svg.desc.power: Bars show the load in watts; the red line shows the measured pulse on the right axis.
chart.svg.desc.pulse: Bars show interval targets in bpm; red points show the measured pulse and a dashed line shows the progress.
chart.drag.repeatWork: Drag to change all hard intervals in the repeat
chart.drag.repeatRecovery: Drag to change all easy intervals in the repeat
chart.drag.pulse: Drag to change the interval's target pulse
chart.drag.durationWork: Drag to change the duration of all hard intervals
chart.drag.durationRecovery: Drag to change the duration of all easy intervals
chart.drag.duration: Drag to change the session's duration
choose.title: Choose workout
choose.help: The workout loads as soon as you choose it. Shared templates are never overwritten. Adjust the workout and save it under a new name in »Adjust and save the current workout plan«.
recovery.placed: The pulse drop has been placed right after the last load, and the easy ending has been removed: {removed}.
recovery.already: The workout already ends with a pulse drop.
template.message.hiit-30-30: The HIIT template is ready: 4 min warm-up at 80 W, 13 × (30 s at 150 W + 30 s at 50 W) and 3 min cool-down. Adjust the watts to your fitness.
template.message.pulse-3x3: The pulse intervals are ready: 5 min warm-up, 3 × (3 min at 85 % + 3 min at 65 % of max pulse) and 3 min cool-down. The number of repeats and the lengths can be changed in the block.
template.message.pulse-4x4: The 4 × 4 template is ready: 5 min warm-up at 65 %, 4 × (4 min at 90 % + 3 min at 70 % of max pulse) and a pulse drop right after the last hard interval. 31 min in all. The hard minutes should feel hard: you can say short sentences, but not hold a conversation.
template.message.vo2max-5x5: The VO₂ Max template is ready: 9 min warm-up, 5 × (1 min at 285 W + 1¼ min at 130 W) and 8 min cool-down. Adjust the watts to your fitness.
template.message.astrand: The Åstrand test is ready: 3 min warm-up, 6 min at {watts} W (3:00-9:00) and a pulse drop (9:00-10:00). The pulse is measured from 7:00 to 9:00, once it has settled, and must end between 120 and 170 (suggestion: women 75 W, men 100 W, more if you are fit). Keep an even cadence of about 60 rpm.
template.message.ramp-test: The ramp test is ready: 5 min at 50 W, then the load rises 20 W per minute. Ride until you cannot go on, then press Stop (or stop pedalling): the pulse drop is then measured for 60 s. The pulse limit is switched off. Talk to your doctor first if you are not used to all-out efforts.
template.block.astrand: Åstrand test: 6 min at a fixed load; the pulse is measured in the last 2 min
template.block.ramp: Ramp: ride until you cannot go on, then press Stop
plan.title: Adjust and save the current workout plan
mode.pulse: By pulse (pulse targets in % of maximum pulse)
mode.help.power: The load follows the plan. If the pulse goes above 95 % of maximum pulse, the load is lowered automatically.
mode.help.pulse: The load is adjusted to keep the pulse on target.
block.recovery: Pulse drop – sit still on the bike
save.label: Save as
save.help: Saved for the chosen user under »My saved workouts«. Pulse targets are saved as a percentage of maximum pulse, so they fit the user's maximum pulse. Use a new name to save a copy.
profile.title: User profile
profile.details.help: Used to calculate your VO₂max in the fitness tests.
profile.ownership: Maximum pulse, smartwatch and saved workouts belong to the chosen user.
maxPulse.prompt: Choose a maximum pulse or enter a year of birth.
maxPulse.help: The maximum pulse is saved on the profile automatically and used in every workout.
maxPulse.formula: Maximum pulse is calculated as 208 − (0.7 × age).
watch.initialHelp: The watch is connected when the workout starts. If a device is listed as unknown, its address can help you identify it in Windows or the Huawei overlay.
watch.savedStatus: Saved smartwatch: {name}. The app tries to connect directly when the workout starts; only search again if the connection fails.
watch.choosePrompt: Search for and choose your smartwatch. The choice is saved on this user profile.
watch.chooseFound: Choose the watch. The choice is saved on the profile; next time the app tries to connect directly.
watch.savedNotFound: The watch was not found just now. The app keeps the saved device; check the watch's Bluetooth heart-rate sharing.
watch.checkSharing: Check that the watch's Bluetooth heart-rate sharing is switched on.
watch.connecting: Connecting to the watch and waiting for a pulse reading...
watch.lost.power: The load follows the plan meanwhile.
watch.lost.pulse: The load is held until the pulse reading comes back.

settings.language.help: Applies to this browser only. The page reloads when you change the language.
bike.help: Saved on this machine and used every time the server starts.
